say:2:1041209001:0.text: Hey, Damian! I bet you've created a ton of cool stuff in the past three years while I was away.
say:2:1041209001:0.source_cn: 嘿，达米安，我离开丛林都三年了，你肯定做出来不少好东西吧？

say:3:1041209002:0.text: Absolutely! I've invented a lot, like the Vinefall Ladder, the Tracking Fisherman's Basket, and the Descending Sky Kite...
say:3:1041209002:0.source_cn: 当然！像什么攀瀑藤梯、追踪捕鱼笼、坠地风筝……

say:4:1041209003:0.text: My most important invention is this—Automated Nurse! I haven't bothered Uncle Dyan again with my injuries. You have no idea how many times it saved me from his scolding!
say:4:1041209003:0.source_cn: 还有最重磅的——自动包扎木头人！自从有了它，我就再也没...

say:6:1041209004:1.source_cn: 哼，你们两个麻烦的小子，这时候凑到一起了！

say:7:1041209005:1.text: Remember how much trouble you caused in the past three years?
say:7:1041209005:1.source_cn: 怎么这时候不提你们这三年闯了多少祸呢！
